answer_1.quote: ShARC, a conversational QA task , requires a system to answer user questions based on rules expressed in natural language text.
answer_1.outputs: The system generates either a Yes/No/Irrelevant answer or a follow-up question in a conversational setting.

answer_2.quote: The following metrics are used in the evaluation of the ShARC task: 1. Micro and Macro Accuracy... 2. BLEU: This is used to assess the correctness of the follow-up question generated in case the model chooses to generate one.
